title.zh: 【谷歌将推出加密托管安全服务，以应对潜在 AI 威胁】
title.en: 【谷歌将推出加密托管安全服务，以应对潜在 AI 威胁】

current_state.zh: Google announced Google Multi-Party Compute (MPC), a security service in private preview that distributes private-key shards across environments to help financial institutions safeguard and transfer crypto and tokenized assets, with launch targeted for early 2027.
current_state.en: Google announced Google Multi-Party Compute (MPC), a security service in private preview that distributes private-key shards across environments to help financial institutions safeguard and transfer crypto and tokenized assets, with launch targeted for early 2027.
